CDS Protocol F - Immune Support

Protocol cds protocol immune wellness

Evidence: Grade C (scientific)

Summary

Immune system support protocol using supportive dosing and reduced frequency for maintenance.

Indications

  • Immune system support
  • General wellness
  • Preventive support
  • Recuperation

Steps

  1. Prepare supportive dose of CDS
  2. Take on a reduced frequency schedule

Dosage

Supportive immune protocol: 1 ml CDS in 100ml water, 1-2 times daily

Expected Outcomes

  • Reduced susceptibility

Monitoring

  • Monitor immune status

  • Adjust dosage as needed
